__doc__: Copy this file to config/dhis2-mapping.json (or set DHIS2_MAPPING_PATH) and replace the UIDs with your own DHIS2 instance's. Each section maps a report-cell code to { dataElement, categoryOptionCombo }. categoryOptionCombo is optional — omit it to fall back to DHIS2_DEFAULT_COC or the data element's default combo. Cell codes: opd-attendance uses `<countKey>|<age group>` (countKey one of insuredNewMale, insuredNewFemale, insuredOldMale, insuredOldFemale, uninsuredNewMale, uninsuredNewFemale, uninsuredOldMale, uninsuredOldFemale); inpatient uses the same shape with countKey one of insured/uninsured + Admission/Death + Male/Female, plus `malaria|<admitted|died>|<under5|5plus>|<Male|Female>`; opd-morbidity uses `<elementKey>|<M|F>|<age group>` where elementKey is the key from MORBIDITY_TAXONOMY in src/lib/morbidity.ts. Age-group labels are exactly: 0-28 days, 1-11 months, 1-4 Years, 5-9 Years, 10-14 Years, 15-17 Years, 18-19 Years, 20-34 Years, 35-49 Years, 50-59 Years, 60-69 Years, 70 Yrs & Above. Keys starting with __ are ignored.
